page.overview:
Who is Meril?

Meril was a Sindar Elf of the North (Northerland) who became the wife of Orodreth and mother of Finduilas and Gil-galad.

After the expulsion of Curufin and Celegorm, Meril was sent away by Orodreth with their young son Gil-galad to the Falathrim in Eglarest, due to the fear "that all strong places were doomed to fall at last before the might of Morgoth".

Meril is the Sindarin word for "rose", used as a name.
